note: atlas-main-smoke-1126: smoke for the merged Atlas main build (boundless-atlas d0be788, atlas 0.3.10; branch feature/atlas-main-queues-1126), about 10 min on Sunset Valley. RUN THIS QUEUE FIRST, before every other atlas-* queue (measurement-smoke rule): job 1 all switches off (startup line, loader A self-check, off lines, SaveBracket status, nothing installed), job 2 probe, loader A and rebase on (one P1 cycle, one loader A cycle, rebase 0 0, a save and a reload).
